'''Mannee Swaano''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]. An ambitious and overly-aggressive braggart, he was a sneaky sales executive who would say anything to close a deal. His coworker, [[Ruku Kooff]], was not particularly fond of him. Mannee was an informant for [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] and alerted the Rodian's Protectors that Ruku was a member of a persecuted clan living under a false identity.
